Load every page of the relevant libraries and compute a read-only cleanup plan. Songs are retained if liked or downloaded; albums are retained if liked or every song ID on the album is downloaded.

```python
def fetch_all_pages(api_function, **kwargs):
    results = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = api_function(page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, **kwargs)
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return results

song_library = fetch_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_song_library, access_token=spotify_access_token)
album_library = fetch_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_album_library, access_token=spotify_access_token)
liked_songs = fetch_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_liked_songs, access_token=spotify_access_token)
liked_albums = fetch_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_liked_albums, access_token=spotify_access_token)
downloaded_songs = fetch_all_pages(apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs, access_token=spotify_access_token)

liked_song_ids = {song["song_id"] for song in liked_songs}
liked_album_ids = {album["album_id"] for album in liked_albums}
downloaded_song_ids = {song["song_id"] for song in downloaded_songs}

song_ids_to_keep = liked_song_ids | downloaded_song_ids
songs_to_remove = [song for song in song_library if song["song_id"] not in song_ids_to_keep]
albums_to_remove = [
    album for album in album_library
    if album["album_id"] not in liked_album_ids
    and not set(album["song_ids"]).issubset(downloaded_song_ids)
]

print({
    "song_library_count": len(song_library),
    "album_library_count": len(album_library),
    "songs_to_remove": [song["song_id"] for song in songs_to_remove],
    "albums_to_remove": [album["album_id"] for album in albums_to_remove],
})
```
